name: clean-and-load
desc: Read the demo cats at least min_age old, tidy them in Go, load them into a new table and stamp a log row.

min_age.doc: The youngest cat to take, in years

cfg.query: SELECT id, name, breed, age, adopted FROM cats WHERE age >= ${min_age} ORDER BY id

cfg.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pipeline_log (pipeline TEXT, fragment TEXT, rows INTEGER, at TEXT);
INSERT INTO pipeline_log VALUES ('clean-and-load', 'clean', ${frag.clean.rows}, datetime('now'))
